Element.attribute: MAR 2022 - renamed from Package Fit Gap Analysis|AUG 2014 - baseline version |

A list of gaps that help communicate key high-level improvements or enhancements and presents a detailed analysis of “out of the box” functionality versus requirements and business processes to the client. The analysis compares both business and system requirements against standard package functionality.

Gap analysis for the package should indicate the degree of fit and:

  • Whether the gap can be supported out of the box
  • The configuration required using administration utilities
  • The configuration required by the vendor
  • Extensions required
  • Core enhancements required
  • Items that cannot be supported
Have a subject matter resource with in-depth experience on the package components perform the analysis.
To determine elements that require custom development because they cannot be met with standard functionality.

• Gap description
  • Priority
  • Effort required to close gap
  • Alternatives / workaround to address gap
  • Proposed recommendation to address gap
